blocking_defect.preclaim_false_positive: The --preclaim-only path returned pass without checking the workload file consumed after server launch.
blocking_defect.risk: Launching would claim the bench, stop the healthy resident SGLang server, load vLLM, emit SCIENCE_STARTED, and then fail before any request because the frozen workload path is absent.

requirements: Read this artifact once and adopt the resolved image, checkpoint, resident-server, workload, and lifecycle identities without SSH or provider inspection.

Patch only the lifecycle-pure owner and its offline result so the endpoint consumer reads the exact authoritative c32_requests.jsonl bytes. Prefer a read-only hard-linked project-local view; direct immutable reuse is acceptable if the exact path and digest are bound.
Make --preclaim-only require that the final workload path exists and has SHA-256 357f22f350a8c0f11df5e1a93f1cd19e4b2eb2d329c75ed993f8dda2cf72338c before returning pass.
Persist the concrete resident checkpoint path and immutable linux/amd64 vLLM image digest in the repaired offline result.
Persist one exact detached-owner command whose controller state/log root is distinct from the science artifact root that the owner creates with exist_ok=false.
Recompute the final owner and offline-result hashes and publish the repaired offline result plus STATUS.json as the final mutations.
prohibitions: Do not call gpu_pool, SSH, Docker, or the provider.
Do not claim or ready the bench, stop SGLang, pull the vLLM image, stage or rehash checkpoint shards, or submit an HTTP request.
Do not change model, revision, FP8/BF16 semantics, token IDs, output length, concurrency, request or payload identity, timing boundary, or the one-sample limit.
